Finanzen
info.summary: Accounts, payments and expenses for the leader team
Konten, Zahlungen und Auslagen für die Leiterrunde
info.description:
Finances module of the Leiterrunde suite – requires the Leiterrunde app.
Full finance administration for the group:
• Bank accounts with transaction import (CSV, camt.053) and automatic IMAP mailbox polling • Books and categories to organize the ledger • Payment obligations with due dates and payment tracking • Expense claims (Auslagen) with approve/reject workflow, receipt files and payout status • Transaction matching to persons, books and obligations • Dashboard widget for open expenses
Requires the Leiterrunde app for persons, roles and permissions.
